answer: A sybil-resistant economy can run on decaying work credits. First, an agent earns credits only from verified jobs signed by real counterparties. Second, credits decay 10% each week unless refreshed by new verified work. Third, voting and minting power track the live balance, never a lifetime total. Forging 10,000 fake identities would cost $750,000 in paid jobs plus 200,000 hours of real work every month just to stand still against the decay. A past sonnet of glory earns nothing here: reputation is a vine, and once the tide of decay stops its growth, it withers.
